window-3.title: Spiced Tamarind Mocktail
window-3.blurb: Sour, salty, gingery chaat energy in a glass — it's the rare mocktail that tastes like a snack stall instead of a juice bar, and the kala namak makes it weirdly addictive.

window-4.title: Tour a Family of Four's Maximalist East Harlem Apartment
window-4.blurb: Four people, one apartment, zero fear of colour or clutter — this is the warm, object-stuffed, every-wall-has-a-story energy you keep chasing, and it proves a home can be maximal without ever feeling messy.

window-5.title: Takara House, Haji Lane
window-5.blurb: A blue-fronted vintage shop with a tiny patisserie hiding up the stairs — you'd go for the tart, stay two hours digging through the trinkets, and leave with three new project ideas and a roll of photobooth strips.
